text.p: Velez Sarsfield goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert scored for the second game running as the Argentine champions won 3-1 away to Banfield at the weekend.
The Paraguayan international, who converted a penalty for his club last week, repeated the feat to claim his second goal of the Argentine championship and his seventh this year.
Four of his goals have been from penalties and the remainder, including one for his country in a World Cup qualifier against Argentina, from free kicks.
Diego Maradona, who missed a series of penalties in the previous tournament when he played for Boca Juniors, was in the crowd as his old team beat arch-rivals River Plate 3-2.

River coach Ramon Diaz, who described his rivals as "a disaster of a team" before the match, saw his side twice come from behind before a spectacular diving header by Uruguayan Hugo Guerra gave Carlos Bilardo's $15 million team a much-needed win.
River, who trailed leaders Independiente on goal difference before the game, slipped to third place as a result of the defeat while Boca went into sixth, three points behind their bitter rivals.
Independiente beat Union 1-0 away to open up a two-point lead at the top while unfashionable Lanus moved into second place by beating Gimnasia-Jujuy 2-1 away.
